items.title: Google DeepMind Releases Gemini 4 Neon: 1M Context, #1 on AA Coding Agent Index
items.summary: Google released Gemini 4 Neon, a 1M-context Gemini 4 model priced at $3/$15 per million tokens. It scores 61 on the AA Intelligence Index and ranks #1 on AA’s Coding Agent Index. The post Google DeepMind Releases Gemini 4 Neon: 1M Context, #1 on AA Coding Agent Index appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Nutrient Data Extraction API: JSON Matching Your Schema With Per-Field Citations and Confidence
items.summary: Nutrient Data Extraction API parses PDFs, scans and Office files into JSON matching your schema. Fields carry page, region and match-label citations, and Studio lets teams test before writing code. The post Nutrient Data Extraction API: JSON Matching Your Schema With Per-Field Citations and Confidence appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: New LoRA Adapter Lifts Qwen3.8 Coding Success From 39% to 65%
items.summary: Hugging Face released Qwen3.8-27B-pi-adapted, an Apache-2.0 LoRA adapter trained with reinforcement learning for the pi coding agent. It lifts SWE-bench Pro hard-51 pass@1 from 39.2% to 64.7% and Terminal-Bench 2.1 from 39.5% to 55.8%. The post New LoRA Adapter Lifts Qwen3.8 Coding Success From 39% to 65% appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: SID AI Releases SID-2 Agentic Search Model With 0.720 NDCG Swarm Mode
items.summary: SID AI released SID-2, an agentic search model trained with reinforcement learning. A single agent reaches 0.585 NDCG in 3.11 seconds, and a 12-agent SID-2 Swarm scores 0.720 NDCG, above GPT-6 Astra on SID’s benchmark. The post SID AI Releases SID-2 Agentic Search Model With 0.720 NDCG Swarm Mode appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Anthropic Adds Code Mode to Claude Code: Claude Now Chains Tool Calls in JavaScript
items.summary: Anthropic has added Code Mode to Claude Code v2.1.323. The experimental feature lets Claude write JavaScript that chains Bash, Read and Edit calls in 1 step, and keep talking while long commands run. The post Anthropic Adds Code Mode to Claude Code: Claude Now Chains Tool Calls in JavaScript appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Perplexity Computer Adds Multiagent: Up to 16 AI Agents That Cross-Check Work
items.summary: Perplexity added Multiagent to Computer, an effort level above Ultra where a lead agent runs up to 16 agents on Claude, GPT and Gemini models that share findings and check each other’s work. The post Perplexity Computer Adds Multiagent: Up to 16 AI Agents That Cross-Check Work appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol With a 20% Cheaper Astra API
items.summary: OpenAI released GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol on November 17, 2026. Astra's API price drops 20% to $8/$40 per million tokens, and it ranks second on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index. The post OpenAI Releases GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol With a 20% Cheaper Astra API appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Clearing Up the Confusion on AI Data Retention: Two Standard Designs Explained
items.summary: Zero data retention applies to specific AI endpoints, not whole vendors. This guide explains the 2 standard API designs for data retention, who manages deletion in each, and 6 checks for developers. The post Clearing Up the Confusion on AI Data Retention: Two Standard Designs Explained appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: NVIDIA Open-Sources NVKE and NVKR for Managed Kubernetes on GPU Infrastructure
items.summary: NVIDIA has open-sourced NVIDIA Kubernetes Engine (NVKE) and NVIDIA Kubernetes Recipes (NVKR) under Apache 2.0. Together they let AI factories run a managed Kubernetes service on their own bare-metal GPU servers. Both are in public preview. The post NVIDIA Open-Sources NVKE and NVKR for Managed Kubernetes on GPU Infrastructure appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Sarvam Launches Sarvam Token Factory: Bringing India-Hosted Inference to 8 Open Models
items.summary: Sarvam Token Factory is now open to everyone. It serves Sarvam 105B, GLM 5.3, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, Kimi K3.1 Pro and Gemma 4 31B from GPU clusters in India through one OpenAI-compatible API. The post Sarvam Launches Sarvam Token Factory: Bringing India-Hosted Inference to 8 Open Models appeared first on MarkTechPost.
